The '''Trandoshan Slavers Guild''' was an organization of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that practiced [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the Guild and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained an enslavement processing center on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]]<ref name="FDCR" /> in the [[Kashyyyk system/Legends|Kashyyyk system]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> The processing center was used to crew Imperial construction projects.<ref name="FDCR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Trandoshan Slavers Guild was mentioned in the [[2015]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]] for ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'', a [[roleplaying game]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="FDCR" />
